summary: A 1954 Cibola National Forest lookout with a 14x14 ft cab on a 10-ft concrete base; NHLR-registered 2006; standing, but current staffing and access are unconfirmed.

facts.design: 14x14 ft cab of local R-3 design, described as CL-100 series in the 2020 chapter report, on a 10-ft concrete block base; catwalk added several years after 1954

events.note: Built in 1954 on the Cibola National Forest; 14x14 ft cab on a 10-ft concrete block base. Westlookouts adds that a storage room was constructed the same year.
Evaluated for the NRHP thematic Lookouts of the Southwest Region nomination; not eligible at that time because of its age
Registered April 30, 2006; nominated by Dave Lorenz
The 2020 chapter report says it should be re-evaluated and nominated if eligible

corrections.why: No source gives the tower's total height. The 10-ft (about 3.0 m) figure is the concrete block base, not the lookout.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register calls the cab a local R-3 design. The 2020 chapter report calls it CL-100 series with a wooden catwalk. Westlookouts calls it an all-steel CL-100 series cab. The 2020 report and westlookouts both use the CL-100 series name; the register does not. The sources differ in wording and detail. The story reports the differences without choosing one.

notes_for_editor: No staffing, fire or access record after 2020 was found. The rental point rests on the chapter report's (C) legend and the Cibola list with no (C) marks. Brief height_m 3.0 is the base height. Campendium and Roadtrippers listings were not used. Searches used: 2.
